vulnerability_analysis: The LoveDoge contract has an owner-only function `sumBounsPiece()` that allows the owner to directly set `dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday]` to any arbitrary value. This value is later used in `_sumCanGetToken()` which calculates `_yesTodayToken = dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday].mul(balancePiece)` and then attempts `dayPoolBouns[yesToday].sub(_yesTodayToken)`. If the owner sets `dayPoolBounsPiece` to an abnormally high value, the subtraction will fail (SafeMath revert) when any user tries to claim bonuses via `receiveBounsToken()`, effectively breaking the bonus distribution mechanism for all users.
attack_strategy: As the contract owner, call `sumBounsPiece(yesToday, veryLargeNumber)` to set `dayPoolBounsPiece` to an excessively high value. This will cause the subtraction in `_sumCanGetToken()` to revert when users attempt to claim bonuses, demonstrating the owner privilege abuse vulnerability.
